coder: Claude (agent), 28/10/2026, after review by Codex; not blind to outcomes, not a human coder
rule: For each requirement, a quote from the sentence of the documentation snapshot that states the omitted obligation of arm A. A passage is semantic gold when its markup-stripped, whitespace-normalised text contains the quote (case-insensitive), in any file of the snapshot. Quotes were located by reading arm A and searching the snapshot; the lexical gold of v1 is kept for comparison.
